text_block_list.text:
To let Calstone Light O rest since he didn't seem to be feeling well,
I accompanied him to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
I'm going to lie down for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Where on earth is this?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: The scenery around me keeps changing so fast... Ah, everything is rushing past in a blur.

"Bwahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
Bwahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon?
text_block_list.text: An anomaly running at ultra-high speed is truly fascinating, isn't it? But dear me, this makes it impossible to measure an accurate time, and for an entity even Cafe cannot communicate with—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe?
text_block_list.text: Indeed my "friend" also says it is an extremely troublesome entity at this rate it will erode the real world in any case so we don't lose sight of it—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Talking fast and bustling around.
Were those two always like that?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Let's chase after them for now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, caught up. You two look completely bizarre, but are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, the whole world is weird.
Tell me what happened.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon?
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh! Look there, it's the "Ghost Biker"!
They say even in death, he wanders around at breakneck speeds!
It seems his influence is making the entire world move in double ti—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe?
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my coffee cools down in no time.
I'm sure if we could overtake them for just a moment they'd give up and pass on in peace,
but we aren't particularly suited for sprinting, so...

text_block_list.name: Ghost Biker
text_block_list.text: (VROOM! VRRRROOOOOOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Alright, I get it. You're in trouble, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: So all I have to do is overtake that pitch-black bike.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ha—!!

text_block_list.name: Ghost Biker
text_block_list.text: (SKRRRR-VRRRROOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
The idea that mere ghosts could run faster than me!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm the only one who needs to be this fast!
In a world moving this quickly, everyone else would suffer!
I can't let everyone suffer! That's why—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH--!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—Kh!
......Was that a dream?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember it clearly, but I overtook them.
I am the fastest!
